text:
alice (oncall): Seeing a sudden apiserver 502/503 spike in ap-southeast1 starting ~1708501200. GUI + metrics show watch reconnects and client resets. Any recent infra pushes? :thinking:
carol (prov): We rolled a change to the GPU provisioner yesterday to increase parallel attaches from 10 -> 40 to speed onboarding. Could be related.
dan (runtime): Logs from the apiserver frontends show a lot of short-lived connections 1-2s and high backend connection churn. Could be NAT port exhaustion upstream.
erin (sre): Agree with dan — conntrack and SNAT ports look suspect. Can someone run `kubectl get events -n kube-system --field-selector` on apiserver proxies and provisioner pods? I can tail conntrack counts if you want.
carol (prov): On it. Quick note: provisioner started ~1200 parallel attach attempts across pods in the last 5m per prometheus.
bob (net): I'm seeing SNAT port usage hit 64k on the egress gateway. Cloud NAT reports ephemeral port exhaustion across 3 nodes.
prov-bot: Incident alert: nat-snat-exhaustion ap-southeast1 detected (severity: warning).
alice (oncall): That explains the apiserver 5xxs. When SNAT is exhausted, TCP fails and kube clients see watch disconnects -> high reconnection fanout.
carol (prov): Rolling back the attach-parallelism patch now to 10. Pushing a canary config to two provisioner replicas.
dan (runtime): Thx. Also reduce the provisioner retry storm: add jitter and backoff to attach retries (temporary override).
erin (sre): I'm scaling up the NAT gateways (requested spike capacity) and opening a ticket with cloud provider for longer-term port increase. Also enabling connection tracking metrics on the proxies.
bob (net): Quick mitigation: add a short-lived egress pool by routing new provisioner subnets through spare NATs in us-east region? Might be slower but reduces local SNAT pressure. Want me to wire a route?
alice (oncall): Do it. Lower risk than letting apiserver remain unstable.
carol (prov): Canary rollback completed on two replicas at 1708501238. Monitoring attach rate.
prov-bot: Deploy status: rollback-success (provisioner-config v2 -> v1).
dan (runtime): Observed client reconnect rate for apiserver down 45% after rollback. k8s watch latency dropping.
erin (sre): NAT ports freed up after rollback and cloud support started scaling. apiserver 5xxs declined to baseline.
bob (net): Confirmed new routing rule applied at 1708501252. Egress distribution looks even now.
alice (oncall): Great. Action items: 1) carol - add default backoff/jitter and cap parallel attaches in prov config; 2) dan - harden apiserver clients to exponential backoff on watch reconnect; 3) erin/bob - request permanent NAT port increase or add pooled NATs for high-churn regions; 4) open postmortem with timeline + cost impact.
carol (prov): Will open PR with conservative defaults and an integration test for conn churn.
dan (runtime): I'll add a client-side circuit breaker for excessive reconnects.
erin (sre): Adding runbook entry for NAT exhaustion symptoms + quick mitigations.
alice (oncall): Marking this thread resolved for now. If 5xxs reappear, escalate to pager. :white_check_mark:
